brief.concept: How to Use Propeller’s MLB Fantasy Projections: Floor, Ceiling & Sit/Start
brief.primary_question: How do I use Propeller's MLB Fantasy projections to compare hitters using floor, projected points, ceiling, and Sit/Start?
brief.audience: New and prospective Propeller users, especially fantasy baseball players who want a transparent daily player comparison.
brief.learning_outcome: The viewer can confirm the slate and scoring basis, interpret all three projection values, sort the board, compare two hitters on desktop and mobile, and understand the product's limitations.
brief.cta: Open Propeller Picks on web or mobile and run a current MLB Sit/Start comparison.
brief.freshness_requirements: Capture the live product after script approval; show current slate date and update status; do not narrate player names or exact values that can go stale.
